prompt_sections: Revise reference image 1 into the accepted environment-only production reference. Reference image 2 is style/world guidance only.

Keep the beautiful cream/coral orbital greenhouse lane, crisp horizontal footing, exposed structural depth, botanical terraces, curved glazing, clean controlled contours, digital-gouache/cel-painted finish, and optimistic repair-garden mood.
Use one consistent pale-blue orbital daylight illumination from the left edge through the right edge; no day-to-night split.
Make the leftmost and rightmost 15% calm and closely compatible in horizon, glazing rhythm, floor datum, color, brightness, foliage density, and structural motif.
Remove the dominant center support column and any centerpiece; replace it with a distributed, low-contrast rhythm of slender distant greenhouse ribs.
Keep the full running lane unobstructed and laterally readable across the entire frame.
Preserve a crisp walk-surface edge around the lower-quarter datum and rich but subordinate machinery below it.
Keep upper trusses and hanging foliage sparse enough not to block silhouettes.
One tiny distant moon may remain high in the sky, away from both edges.
Output one wide 3:2 landscape image, full bleed, no frame or panels.

Strict exclusions: no people, children, pilots, characters, robots, drones, creatures, vehicles, silhouettes, faces, statues, mannequins, hazards, obstacles, pickups, coins, collectible trails, HUD, UI, signage, typography, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, franchise imagery, platform gaps, or perspective road vanishing into depth.
